verdict.rationale: A data-training policy or opt-out is a fair question for an email-infrastructure SaaS that stores customer message content, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a no-training commitment or a training opt-out. SOC 2 reports, Pod data isolation, scoped API keys and the community-mentioned Bring Your Own Cloud option are adjacent security and privacy controls that do not address model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
